scope: Proposition 5.1 (Contraction bound) of the manuscript “Near-square-root logarithmic integrality gaps for uniform sparsest cut” (preprints/Near-square-root-logarithmic-integrality-gaps-for-uniform-sparsest-cut-September-24-2026/Near-square-root-logarithmic-integrality-gaps-for-uniform-sparsest-cut-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 117 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d47a50531670a4f9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (V, d) and the chart maps vs : U → V be those of Proposition 4.2, where U = (−2, 2)m, 1 ≤ s ≤ S = m3, and N = m6. There is an absolute constant C such that every map F : V → ℓD 1 , for every finite D, satisfying ∥F(v) − F(w)∥1 ≤ d(v, w) (v, w ∈ V ) obeys Eθ,η∈T ∥F(v1(θ)) − F(v1(η))∥1 ≤ C √ m (log m)5/2 , (5.1) where T = (−1, 1)m and the two parameters are independent and uniform.
